title: Attack Surface, Trust Boundary, and Blast Radius
description: An interactive SVG of a 3-tier web app that distinguishes three security ideas on one picture: the red dashed attack surface, two solid blue trust boundaries, and two amber dashed blast-radius circles, with hover tooltips explaining each.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Distinguish attack surface, trust boundary, and blast radius as three different questions about one system.
Trace what a compromise of the app tier versus the data tier can reach.
Explain how trust boundaries and least privilege shrink the blast radius.

instructionalStrategies: Hover the attack-surface points first, then the boundaries, then the blast circles, keeping the three concepts separate.
Ask students how each control (WAF, least-privilege DB creds, segmentation) changes one of the three.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why is the blast radius of stolen DB credentials larger than the blast radius of an app-server compromise here?
Which control most reduces attack surface, and which most reduces blast radius?
